en.headline: Water supply restored to Tuen Mun estates after two-day repairs
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department said supply gradually resumed from 6 pm on Thursday to estates including Yi Fung Court, Hin Fat Estate, Hang Shun Garden and Koon Fung Garden after further leak repairs.
body: Fresh water supply to several Tuen Mun estates was progressively restored from about 6 pm on Thursday after emergency repairs to a leaking main near Fu Fat Lane and a subsequent leak on Tuen Hing Road.

The Water Supplies Department had earlier suspended supply overnight on Tuesday and again on Wednesday evening while engineers tackled the faults. Affected locations included Yi Fung Court, Hin Fat Estate, Hang Shun Garden, Koon Fung Garden and Tuen Mun Government Secondary School, serving several thousand residents.

Temporary water tankers and tanks were deployed during the suspension. The department said it had coordinated closely with the Tuen Mun District Office, the Housing Department, district councillors and estate management offices to support residents. Normal supply was expected to stabilise once residual air was cleared from the pipes.

zh.headline: 屯門多個屋苑傍晚起陸續恢復食水供應
zh.dek: 水務署表示，經過兩日搶修富發里及屯興路水管漏點後，怡峰園、顯發邨、恒順園及冠峰園等屋苑星期四傍晚六時起陸續恢復供水。
body: 屯門多個屋苑的食水供應於星期四傍晚約六時起陸續恢復。水務署早前因青山公路近富發里地盤內水管滲漏，以及其後在屯興路發現的新漏點，先後於星期二及星期三晚上安排緊急停水進行搶修。
受影響範圍包括怡峰園、顯發邨、恒順園、冠峰園及屯門官立中學，涉及數千名居民。停水期間水務署已安排水車及水箱提供臨時供水。
水務署表示，已與屯門民政事務處、房屋署、區議員及屋苑管理處保持緊密聯繫，為有需要居民提供支援。管道內殘餘空氣清除後，供水可望回復穩定。
